svg.text: A creator tool for turning rough story ideas into visual pose references

g.text: 1. Start with a scene prompt: character, emotion, action, camera angle, and composition.
2. Generate pose boards for illustrators, animators, thumbnails, comics, and short-form video.
3. Keep the workflow practical: fast references first, polished image generation only when useful.
4. Potential buyers: indie creators, storyboard artists, comic makers, and content teams.

svg.text: MVP: prompt-to-pose reference sheets with reusable character/style presets.
